title: Design System: 陈远｜每日策展

signal.purpose: Agent-engineering terms in the signal field only.

components.name: External Link Pill
components.description: The single external identity link beneath the profile name.
components.css: .ds-external-link { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; border:1px solid #1c1c1e; border-radius:999px; background:#1c1c1e; color:#fff; font:620 12px/1 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,Arial,sans-serif; padding:9px 13px; text-decoration:none; transition:background-color 180ms ease,border-color 180ms ease; }.ds-external-link:hover,.ds-external-link:focus-visible { border-color:#555; background:#555; outline:0; }

components.name: Curation Stream Row
components.description: A flat three-column item for date/author, content, and direction.
components.html:
2026年8月7日
@author一条每日策展标题↗
components.css: .ds-stream-row { display:grid; grid-template-columns:minmax(124px,.42fr) minmax(0,1.58fr) 20px; gap:16px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee; color:#1c1c1e; font:12px/1.38 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,Arial,sans-serif; padding:26px 0; text-decoration:none; }.ds-stream-row strong { font-size:17px; font-weight:570; letter-spacing:-.04em; line-height:1.15; }.ds-stream-row:hover,.ds-stream-row:focus-visible { color:#6f6f72; outline:0; }

components.name: Technical Signal
components.description: An irregular, sparse Agent vocabulary field; not a tag cloud.
components.css: .ds-signal { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:18px 32px; min-height:96px; background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(28,28,30,.27) 1px,transparent 1.15px); background-size:9px 9px; padding:18px; }.ds-signal span { border:1px solid rgba(28,28,30,.22); background:rgba(255,255,255,.94); color:rgba(28,28,30,.88); font:650 10px/1 ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,monospace; padding:7px 9px; }

narrative.overview: A flat, high-contrast personal engineering site. The profile rail remains stable while curation entries and long-form detail create a continuous reading flow.

rules.name: Monochrome After Loading
rules.body: Loader Green ends with the loading sequence; content pages use black, white, and gray.

rules.name: Flat By Default
rules.body: Use separators and whitespace rather than cards and shadows.

dos: Use the identity rail plus continuous content flow.
Keep profile copy full-width inside the rail.
donts: Do not restore knowledge-base workspace UI.
Do not use card grids or decorative color accents.
Do not let signal terms overlap.
